# land2grid

> land2grid coordinates land management, grid connectivity and industrial customer acquisition for IPPs and EPCs building solar and wind projects in India.

## Services

- [What we do](https://land2grid.com/services/what-we-do.html): land, grid connectivity and industrial offtake, run end to end by one team
- [Land management](https://land2grid.com/services/land-management.html): site identification, landowner negotiation, title and survey diligence
- [Grid connectivity](https://land2grid.com/services/grid-connectivity.html): CTU/STU connectivity applications, substation and evacuation planning
- [Industrial customer acquisition](https://land2grid.com/services/customer-acquisition.html): open access and captive demand mapping, PPA structuring support
